presentations.more: This loop moves `expr` one step along `expression` at a time, and its only way out is the condition — reaching the end of the chain. The analysis cannot place `expression` on one declaration, so nothing proves the chain it makes ever ends. On such data the chain has no end: the condition never becomes false, nothing in the loop leaves it, and the thread running it spins at full CPU for as long as the process lives. Nothing here counts the steps or remembers the objects already visited.

specs.description:
`build-mcp-metadata.ts` — Build-mcp-metadata. Called from `serve.ts (top level)` and `stdio.ts (top level)`, and possibly from places the call graph cannot see. `main` is where the program ends. `buildTemplate` builds `dependencies`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside it. Can fail: “`lambda_743_20` can fail with the error "src/images/catalog.json: no photo for".” 4 requirements: 4 violated. 2 stated failures.

2 findings reachable from current code produced no requirement — on `buildTemplate` (1): a value is used as present without a check; on `literalValue` (1): the analysis reports a reachable failure.
